paragraphs.source_en: The intuition is that whereas inflationary cosmology imagines the observ able universe getting ever smaller at ever earlier times -and hence being ever hotter, denser, and energetic-stringlM-theory tames this unruly (in physics-speak, "singular") behavior by introducing a minimal size (as in our discussion on pages 3 50-3 5 1 ) below which new and less singular physical quantities become relevant. This reasoning lies at the heart of stringlM-theory's successful merger of general relativity and quantum mechanics, and my gut feeling is that we will shortly determine how to apply the same reasoning in the context of cosmology. But, as of now, the fuzzy patch still looks fuzzy, and it's anybody's guess when clarity will be achieved. The second approach employs the braneworld scenario, and in its most radical incarnation posits a completely new cosmological frame work.

Of course, on closer scrutiny we learn that cyclic phenomena also have a beginning and end, since cycles do not generally go on forever. The sun has been rising and setting-that is, the earth has been spinning on its axis while revolving around the sun - every day for some 5 billion years.
